title: CI: add Rocky Linux 9 FIPS target
description: Rocky Linux 9 is a free 1:1 RHEL rebuild with FIPS mode support. Add as a CI target: boot instance, run fips-mode-setup --enable + reboot, verify fips-mode-setup --check, then run full test suite. Tests the RHEL FIPS kernel path at no extra cost. Prerequisite for RHEL FIPS certification confidence.
